text:
marta g: Uploaded updated dark theme mocks and a short checklist. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123 (screens + tokens). Main asks: warmer surface (not pure black), clearer code block syntax, and a chart palette that works for colorblind readers.

chris p: Skimmed — warmer surface sounds good. Implementation notes: we use CSS vars for tokens, so changing surface/background is low effort. Avoid pure #000 as it crushes shadows. :+1:

marta g: Agreed. Proposed base tokens (draft):
```css
:root {
  --bg: #0B0F12; /* page background */
  --surface: #101418; /* main panels */
  --elev: #14181B; /* raised */
  --text: #E6EEF1;
  --muted: #AFC2C7;
}
```
Would like contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text and >= 3:1 for secondary UI.

eva (a11y): These numbers look reasonable. Please verify with actual contrast tool; some token combos (muted on surface) can slip below 3:1. Also avoid relying on color alone for status (red/green).

alex r: For charts I recommend a colorblind-safe set — keeping saturation moderate so lines are visible on dark surfaces. My suggestion (hexs):
```
#5BC0EB  #FFB86B  #8AD07A  #F28C8C  #B39DDB
```
They map to blue / amber / green / coral / violet — avoids red/green pairings and reads OK in grayscale.

jordan: Copy nit — in the theme toggle, change label from `Dark` to `Dark (Recommended for low-light)`? Maybe too long. Suggest: `Dark (low-light)` or keep simple `Dark` and add a tooltip.

marta g: Tooltip sounds better. Short label + info icon. Also thinking about syntax highlighting palette for code blocks. Current proposal: keywords purple, functions blue, strings green, numbers orange. Example:
```
keyword: #C792EA
function: #82AAFF
string: #A8E070
number: #F78D70
comment: #6B7881
```
Need to check contrast on comments for small text.

chris p: Those swatches look fine. One constraint: our markdown renderer overlays a subtle shadow on code blocks; extremely light colors can wash out. I'll tweak token brightness in CSS variables so we can keep the optical balance.

eva (a11y): Please run the comment color through AA small text — if it fails, bump opacity or use slightly brighter gray. Also ensure focus outlines meet 3:1 against surface.

alex r: For the dashboard heatmap, avoid using red/green diverging without a secondary indicator. Use a diverging palette + pattern or icon for outliers. We should also consider using thicker strokes for line charts on dark to improve legibility at small widths.

marta g: Good call. I'll update the Figma frames:
- tokens page with final hexs and contrast numbers
- chart component with alt patterns for accessibility
- theme toggle tooltip copy

design-bot: New Figma file version published by marta g: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123?node-id=42 — "dark-theme-v3"

chris p: I'll open a PR after I sync with the token names. Expect a draft with CSS var mapping and code block update by EOD tomorrow.

jordan: Quick: can we change the Settings page header color to use --surface instead of --bg? It reads better visually when the header floats.

marta g: Yes — that will be in the token update. Thanks everyone. Can folks react with :+1: if they sign off on these tokens so I can finalize?

alex r: +1

eva (a11y): +1 (pending final contrast check)

chris p: +1

jordan: +1

marta g: Thanks — I'll post the final token list once contrast checks pass.
